basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer from Seattle, Washington. I have a deep love for nostalgia and frequently find myself reminiscing about the books and games from my childhood. In my spare time, I enjoy collecting vintage computer programs and exploring different storytelling mediums. I'm currently single and spend a lot of my evenings online, diving into new hobbies and connecting with fellow enthusiasts. I'm fairly new to Reddit, but I find it a great source for rekindling forgotten interests. My work keeps me busy during the day, but I'm typically online in the evenings and late at night.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in graphic design and have worked in the digital media industry for the past five years. My knowledge is a mix of formal education and self-taught skills, especially in digital illustration and UI/UX design. I also have a keen interest in old computer software and games, which I explore as a hobby.
